answer: To resist sybil attacks, the agent economy must enforce a cost-to-identity ratio that scales superlinearly. Each identity requires a staked collateral locked for N epochs and a proof-of-work attestation. Reputation is non-transferable and tracked on a public ledger. Attacker cost grows with cluster size; detection via fingerprinting exposes patterns. The system validates execution through consensus and slashes cheaters. Words: quartz, thread, ripple.
